meta.notes: The pass: a walled teahouse and truck halt on a high pass road, at night, in winter. Eight men in four rooms round a yard under snow; the snow is in the file (ground, drifts, caps, trodden paths, ruts), laid by hand. Two ways in: the road west of the gate, and the back of the kitchen outside the wall. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts pass
